title: Development and in vitro evaluation of 1,4,7-triazacyclononane-coupled β-lactams against metallo-β-lactamase producing bacteria
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23427-23440
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01842K, Paper

Mbongeni Shungube, Nakita Reddy, Terisha Ghazi, Kimberleigh B. Govender, Ravesh Singh, Afsana Kajee, Anil Chuturgoon, Hendrik G. Kruger, Per I. Arvidsson, Dileep Tiwari, Thavendran Govender, Tricia Naicker
Eight new MBL inhibitors, designed using a 1,4,7-triazacyclononane (NO3PY) chelator linked to a β-lactam, restored the efficacy of meropenem, reducing its minimum inhibitory concentration against MBL-expressing pathogens.
